name: Dimension Pendulum-Alert
descriptionTemplate:
{Multiply}: The first time each Awakener plays a "Skill" each turn, generate 2 Temporary Base Copies of it. When a Command Card with an Arithmetica Cost of 0 or 1 is played, all Awakeners gain 5 Aliemus.
{Bastion}: When a card with a Default Arithmetica Cost of 3 or more is played, all enemies gain Shield equal to 20% of their Max HP.
